title: SmokeBuddy Junior Air Filter
description:
SmokeBuddy Junior
The smokebuddy junior, well in this case the vapour buddy. Your very own personal air filter. This handy little device makes your exhaled vapour literally disappear. This includes the smell and the sight of you vapour. It also has the ability to literally make smoke disappear so vapour is an easy job for the smokebuddy. All this happens due to the activated charcoal that is inside your smokebuddy.
To use simply exhale your vapour through your smokebuddy junior then re-apply the 2 caps when your finished. It really is that simple.
You can expect to get a good amount of use out of a smokebuddy junior but there will come a time when the inside of your smokebuddy gets a bit on the eww side and you may want to replace it at that stage.
The smokebuddy junior is extremely effective and can easily fit in your pocket but if you want an air filter that has better flow then the smokebuddy original may be a better option. Click
HERE
.
Included
1 x SmokeBuddy Junior (Black)
